propositions: The inbound link differ is ADD-only by design and never removes local deps when peer links are deleted in Jira
Removing a link in Jira leaves the corresponding local ticket dependency intact indefinitely with no pass reporting it
The asymmetry between inbound (no removal path) and outbound (has removal path) link diffing violates the J11 mutation table row 11 oracle that requires deleted peer links to be absent locally

A correction design using per-binding peer-state history (similar to 1296's parent pattern) can distinguish never-pushed local links from truly deleted peer links, but ecosystem research shows link deletion propagation is not commonly implemented by comparable tools
The shipped semantics defer removal mirroring and implement local-wins-and-restore where peer-deleted links are re-added on the next pass, convergent and safe from data loss
